item.title: CVE-2026-81346 — Frontend Admin by DynamiApps < 3.29.11 - Subscriber+ Arbitrary Membership Plan Deletion
item.description: The Frontend Admin by DynamiApps WordPress plugin before 3.29.11 does not perform a capability check on one of its AJAX actions, allowing any authenticated user, such as a subscriber, to delete arbitrary membership plans.
